body: Pabrai Investment Funds since 1999. Long-run record is murky: an app-store bio claims >28% net since inception (unreliable); a profile says $100,000 at inception became $1.207m by 30 Jun 2017 (~14.8% annualised) - the more checkable figure. The funds reportedly fell ~60-70% peak-to-trough in 2008-09 (unverified). Process: 'heads I win, tails I don't lose much'; a few concentrated bets in simple businesses in distress; openly clone other great investors' positions (13Fs, Indian superstar filings); checklists built from past errors. Signature trades: Fiat Chrysler (~2012-18, large gain), Rain Industries (India; bought ~2015 at ~$0.60/share, i.e., about Rs 40, rose roughly 10x by early 2018 - it and Fiat were his most concentrated positions in Jan 2018 - then gave back most of the gain), US coal miners in 2021-22 (large gains, unverified). India book later: Edelweiss Financial (7-8% stake 2023-24, under 1% by Sep 2025), Sunteck Realty (~6.7%). Mistakes: Horsehead Holdings (zinc recycler, bankrupt 2016 - near total loss); round-trips in cyclical commodity names (Rain) when he did not sell near peak margins. Copyable: cloning as idea sourcing, a written checklist, few bets; but in cyclicals sell when margins and P/B are peak, not when P/E looks low.

data.signature_trades: Fiat Chrysler, Rain Industries (~10x then round-trip), coal 2021-22

title: Mohnish Pabrai - Dhandho, cloning, and concentrated India/commodity bets
